mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing imperfect memory farewell. Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three clothing, carried-object or gait anchors across at least five ordinary chapters. Use one object, route direction, weather transition or repeated movement to connect each chapter. Preserve bounded handheld imperfections—late pans, partial occlusions, focus recovery and uneven horizons—without losing the subject. Let activity density decrease after one weather or emotional crest and end on a quieter departure or hold. Do not copy source person, city, streetcar, basketball, storm, diner, rooftop, exact camera or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original subject with at least three stable anchors across five ordinary chapters.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing subject or wardrobe makes separate stories.

invariants.rule: Connect each chapter with one object, route direction, weather change or repeated motion.
invariants.purpose: Creates a day rather than random clips.

invariants.rule: Use bounded handheld imperfections but always recover subject and anchor.
Place one weather or emotional crest before decreasing activity density.
invariants.purpose: Gives the day a temporal shape.
invariants.ablation_failure: Uniform energy prevents a felt ending.

invariants.rule: End on a quiet departure or hold with the same adult and at least one anchor visible.
invariants.ablation_failure: A new spectacle resets rather than closes the day.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source young adult man, face, clothes, backpack and gait
source coffee, streetcar, basketball and diner actions
source New Orleans-like streets, court, storm and rooftop
source exact handheld errors, focus recovery and chapter order
source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording, timing and camera
